name: Soukai no Oujo-tachi
source: A long lasting war depleted all the resources even the manpower. To break the deadlock, a new submarine called Uldiana is launched. There are only female soldiers on it and Arl, the captain, is one and only man on board...
translation: 一场旷日持久的战争耗尽了所有资源，甚至连人力也所剩无几。为打破僵局，新型潜艇“乌尔迪亚娜”正式下水。艇上只有女性士兵，舰长阿尔是唯一的男性……
